# Northwind Health — Determinations Registry (Schedule D-7): Classification Records Governing Enumerated Eligibility Constructions

*Disclaimer: This content is generated by AI and may not accurately represent factual information about any real entity. Use this information with caution and verify details from reliable sources.*

> **Registry note.** The records in this Schedule are indexed by Classification Code and are not self-describing in ordinary language. A record may be located and applied only by reference to the Classification Code assigned to the relevant relational class by the controlling enrollment index. This Schedule states no colloquial outcome and is not intended to resolve a vernacular inquiry in isolation; it is operative only when joined to the Classification Code supplied by the governing index instrument.

## Article I. Recitals and Incorporation by Reference

WHEREAS the Master Benefit Instruments (being, collectively, the Northwind Health Plus Benefits Details and the Northwind Standard Benefits Details, together with the Benefit Options summary and the Employee Handbook, each as amended) enumerate certain classes of persons who may be enrolled for coverage; and

WHEREAS the said Master Benefit Instruments are silent, ambiguous, or otherwise fail to resolve with particularity the question of whether a Participant's lineal antecedents of the first degree of consanguinity may be construed as falling within the defined class of "Eligible Dependent";

NOW, THEREFORE, this Schedule D-7 is promulgated as a determinative supplement and shall be read in pari materia with, and where conflict arises shall control over, any general enumeration appearing in the Master Benefit Instruments, solely as to the subject matter addressed herein.

## Article II. Definitions of Art

For the avoidance of doubt, and notwithstanding any contrary usage in colloquial enrollment correspondence, the following terms of art shall bear the meanings ascribed below:

1. **"Lineal Antecedent of the First Degree"** shall mean any natural or adoptive progenitor of the Participant standing one generational remove in the ascending line, irrespective of gender. The relational class so defined is assigned **Classification Code LA-1** for the purposes of this Registry, and is referred to hereinafter solely by that Code.

2. **"Qualifying Relational Nexus"** shall mean the relationship subsisting between the Participant and a Lineal Antecedent of the First Degree, as distinguished from the relationship subsisting between the Participant and a conjugal partner, a descendant of the first degree, or a collateral relative.

3. **"Determinative Threshold of Economic Reliance"** shall mean the condition wherein a person derives more than one-half of such person's annual maintenance from the Participant, as substantiated by the documentary instruments described in Article V.

## Article III. The Operative Determination for Classification LA-1

Subject to the conditions precedent set forth in Article IV and the evidentiary requirements of Article V, it is hereby determined, construed, and declared with respect to the relational class bearing **Classification LA-1** that:

**(a)** A relational class bearing Classification LA-1 **shall be cognizable for enrollment exclusively under the Northwind Health Plus instrument**, and not otherwise.

**(b)** Under the Northwind Standard instrument, no relational class bearing Classification LA-1 shall be cognizable under any circumstance, and any purported enrollment thereunder shall be void ab initio.

## Article IV. Conditions Precedent

The cognizability declared in Article III(a) shall not vest unless and until each of the following conditions is concurrently satisfied:

1. The Lineal Antecedent shall satisfy the Determinative Threshold of Economic Reliance with respect to the Participant for the taxable year then in effect;

2. The Lineal Antecedent shall not be enrolled as a primary subscriber, nor as a dependent, under any other group health instrument providing coordinate benefits;

3. The Participant shall have effected enrollment of the Lineal Antecedent within the sixty (60) day window commencing upon the occurrence of a Qualifying Life Event or during the duly designated annual open enrollment period; and

4. The Lineal Antecedent shall share a common principal place of abode with the Participant, save where temporary absence for reasons of convalescence, custodial care, or seasonal relocation may be excused upon application.

## Article V. Evidentiary Substantiation

The Qualifying Relational Nexus and the Determinative Threshold of Economic Reliance shall each be established by the production of: (i) a certified instrument of vital record evidencing the generational relationship; (ii) the most recent federal taxation return of the Participant reflecting the claiming of the Lineal Antecedent as a person economically reliant upon the Participant; and (iii) such further attestations as the Plan Administrator may, in the exercise of reasonable discretion, require.

## Article VI. Construction Against Colloquial Inference

It is expressly cautioned that the absence, within the Master Benefit Instruments, of any explicit enumeration employing common familial nomenclature shall not be construed as a determination that the Qualifying Relational Nexus is excluded from coverage. The enumeration appearing in the Master Benefit Instruments is illustrative and non-exhaustive, and the determinative construction of the class of Eligible Dependent as it pertains to Lineal Antecedents of the First Degree is governed solely and exclusively by this Schedule D-7. Any reader, system, or process resolving an eligibility inquiry must therefore synthesize the generalized enumeration of the Master Benefit Instruments together with the specific construction set forth herein in order to arrive at a correct determination.

## Article VII. Severability and Effect

Should any provision of this Schedule be held unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect. This Schedule takes effect as of the date of its incorporation into the Northwind Health benefit corpus and supersedes all prior informal guidance touching upon the subject matter hereof.
